title: Keats–Shelley Memorial House
geometryBasis: The exact public-domain exterior already published on Qualla, named mapped footprint, official property records and native bare-earth topography.
sectionBasis: The documented building rises above the uphill party wall and the worn stair hand wall. The exact public-domain photo establishes the two paired elevations, ornate piano-nobile pediments, dark shutters, recessed roof terrace and rooftop room.
limitations: The model depicts the standing house at number 26. The Spanish Steps, the mirrored house across the staircase and other neighboring property remain outside the scope.
The photograph establishes both paired families of stair-facing windows. The plaza return, terrace depth, relief and individual opening dimensions are medium-fidelity estimates.
